text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I feel so sluggish.
And I don't have any definitive weapon to secure a win."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Plain, ordinary, and no genius.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the protagonist
like Tachyon-chan or Pokke-chan.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Japan Derby...
might not really suit me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still. Even if that were so—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—I want to win. I absolutely want to win.
Win, win, win, win...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'll win!! I want to stand at the very top!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
"I'll—!!
I will—!!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh!!
I'm gonna wiiiiiiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa, haa, haa!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
…………
N-No way—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I couldn't... reach it...! 
I... too—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"My... My 'strongest' is—
Dammiiiiiit—!!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...! ...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dants—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket strode forward with vigor,
—and pulled Dantsu Flame into a hearty embrace.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Ahhh, damn it!
Shoot, that's so frustrating!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm mad, so mad, and it's not even at you!
My head is just a total mess!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
But—!
I'm seriously glad I got to run with you!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Even during training, you start out lookin' like a cute little puppy, but before I know it, you're working out like an absolute demon!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"All that useless junk blew clean out of my head too!
Haha...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Pokke-chan...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...M-Me too!
I'm so glad I got to run with you, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's only because you were there, Pokke-chan,
that I was able to come this far...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because you were always shining so brightly, Pokke-chan,
I knew I definitely... that's why!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—The Kikuka Sho!
Next time, I'm definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there's no way in hell I'm backing down either...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A thunderous round of applause rises from the stands,
as if praising both of their valiant efforts—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A mutual synergy born from a thirst for victory, is it—
Marvelous, that provided some excellent data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Must keep observing from now on, got it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The next race is the 3,000m Kikuka Sho—
the race where the strongest Umamusume wins."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby was truly unfortunate.
However—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: In a sense, standing alongside Pokke-chan... in the center, I kind of thought maybe we did.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"With this momentum, next time for sure—
I have to leave my mark at the Kikuka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby brought a great sense of achievement. In the upcoming Kikuka Sho, I want to climb to even greater heights!
